title: OEC authoritative_answer envelope
description: Schema for the `authoritative_answer` object mirrored onto oec.mcp agent-tool (`agent.*`) responses at the call_tool boundary (v2.5.3 Wave 1 + v2.6 Wave 4 schema 1.1), plus the optional `host_output_diverged` warning added when a host-supplied `claimed_answer` disagrees with it (Wave 2). Schema 1.1 is additive: every 1.0 kind remains valid; `physics_result` is the sole new enum member for multi-domain physics skills. See docs/contracts/authoritative-answer.md for the normative prose.

kind.description: Closed kind taxonomy v1.1 — prefix-derived from the skill id, or a structural kind for extrema/review results. v1.0 kinds are unchanged; physics_result is additive (v2.6).

values.description: For a single execution: execution.result verbatim. For kind=scalar_extrema_result: closed {min, max} shape. For kind=review_result: {passed, checks}.

provenance.description: Non-authoritative bookkeeping (run_id / input_hash / solver_status, or the min/max equivalents for scalar_extrema_result). Never overrides values.

path.description: JSON-Pointer-ish path rooted at authoritative_answer.values, e.g. $.objective_value

authoritative.description: Authoritative value at this path (absent when reason=authoritative_answer_absent).

authoritative_answer_schema_version.description: Additive versioning: envelopes emitted under schema 1.0 remain valid; the boundary emits the maximum supported version (1.1 after v2.6 Wave 4).
